profile.headline: Aspiring Network Engineer | CCNA Candidate
profile.summary: I specialize in front-end development using React and JavaScript to create user-focused, scalable web solutions. I’m skilled in end-to-end development, with expertise in HTML, CSS, and backend technologies like Node.js (runtime environment) and Express.js (framework). I’m adept at deploying remote applications using Docker and AWS to improve team performance. I’m known for my innovative, problem-solving approach and my dedication to delivering results-driven solutions in collaborative Agile team environments.
